rationale: C04 plausibly supplied a concrete component of the child’s catalog of sacrifices: reducing travelers’ duty-free allowance to address the balance-of-payments problem. The child compresses C04’s specific proposal into a public-facing example, retaining its distinctive policy object and purpose. C16 and C14 similarly correspond to the child’s references to incompatible financial interests and feed-grain limitations, but C04 has the clearest combination of shared terminology and policy machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have asked other Americans ... to give up their rights to purchase as many duty-free goods when they are traveling abroad
shared_material.parent_excerpt: returning to the historic basic duty-free allowance of $100 allowed returning American travelers
shared_material.explanation: Both describe the same concrete reduction in the customs exemption for returning American travelers.

shared_material.child_excerpt: all the programs I am seeking—to strengthen ... our balance of payments position
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the United States faces a balance of payments deficit ... we must take into account our balance of payments
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves the specific economic rationale underlying C04’s duty-free allowance proposal.
